scripts.build:clean: find packages apps/playground -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' +
scripts.playground:verify: pnpm run playground:build && node apps/playground/dist/parse-w3c-single.js && node apps/playground/dist/parse-w3c-include.js && node apps/playground/dist/workspace-dag-valid.js && node apps/playground/dist/workspace-dag-cycle.js
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm run build && pnpm run playground:verify
